description: Reads the text in JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or JPEG XL images (scans, screenshots, photos of documents) with Tesseract on this machine. Languages: eng, ron, deu, fra, spa, ita, hun, por, nld, pol, ces, bul, ukr, tur (combine them, e.g. ["ron","eng"]). Low-confidence guesses are dropped; Romanian ş ţ become ș ț. The first use of a language downloads its model (2-15 MB) from app.ionelul.com and caches it; images never leave this machine.

layout.description: Join lines into paragraphs (default) or keep every line break

output.description: Write all the text to this .txt file instead of returning it

title: OCR: text from images
